text: A squad of six British soldiers is dropped by helicopter into the Scottish Highlands for [a training exercise far from anywhere|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], only to find the savaged remains of the SAS unit they were meant to fight. Rescued by a zoologist named Megan, they barricade themselves in an isolated house as, under a full moon, [werewolves surround it|threat|the body turning monstrous]. They must hold out [until sunrise|rules|death on a deadline], while the wounded Captain Ryan keeps quiet about [a government plan to capture a werewolf as a weapon|wants|power over others].
